Process Reward × Normalised KL Divergence (merged paragraphs — length-weighted KL · cumulative ΔAcc)

Each data point = ONE merged monotonic-run paragraph from a student response. normKL is the length-weighted mean of per-token KL across every raw sub-segment in the run. process_reward is the cumulative Δacc_rate across the whole merged paragraph.
KL direction: KL computed on teacher Top-K support (renormalised in S_t). NormKL = length-weighted mean of per-token KL over the merged paragraph.
